verdict.rationale: Parahelp automates ticket handling and can run agents across tickets via automations/API, which implies processing many items over time, but there's no explicit evidence of a bulk-operation interface (e.g., batch-select tickets, bulk edit/close/tag many items at once). missing for 10: explicit bulk-action UI/API for operating on many items simultaneously, evidence of batch size limits or bulk-approval workflows, and confirmation that automations process items in true batch mode rather than one-by-one.
